design_constraint: Preserve very fine-grained and large-grained Foam as distinct appearances to cover; R alone cannot stand in for both. Neither low similarity to R nor switching preferred Foam appearance proves non-Foam or an upper front.
scope: One displayed Foam-interior appearance reference only. No pure-phase per-pixel segmentation, exact upper boundary, adjacent-frame label, global Foam classifier, physical grain-size threshold or independent evaluation follows.
interpretation_limits: The two named appearances are a required coverage distinction, not a calibrated exhaustive size taxonomy. Mixed/transitional appearances remain possible and explicitly unassessed.
Physical bubble size and apparent pixel size are separate; camera/ROI/token scale must be recorded.
Fine/coarse reference scores must remain separate until an aggregation/decision policy is independently justified.
User approval authorizes reference use, not model efficacy or production adoption.
